Union Minister George Kurian Resigns, Cabinet Reshuffle Speculation Grows

Union Minister George Kurian has resigned from his post following the end of his Rajya Sabha term. His resignation comes amid growing speculation about a potential cabinet reshuffle by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. President Droupadi Murmu has accepted Kurian's resignation, and the development has fueled discussions about upcoming changes in the government's ministerial lineup.
